structure: Part 8, Accompanying documents: the live-animals documents feature at src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/documents (repo at main 4c2119da, tag 0.286.0), read in full. One page, /accompanying-documents (page.js), served by controller.js with four routes: GET page, POST page (multipart, add / remove / retry / continue, 10MB+1KiB payload cap with an onPreResponse oversize handler), GET status (JSON for client polling) and GET {uploadId}/file (download). template.njk lays out section caption, heading, guidance (intro, bullet list, closed details expander with an additional-documents table and a GOV.UK link), then a multipart form with a 'File upload' summary card holding reference, document type, MOJ date picker, enhanced govuk file upload, 'Save and add another', the documents-added table (or empty state), a refresh link and timeout hint, then the shared save actions, and an aria-live scan-status announcer. Supporting files: upload-config.js (allowed types, 10MB cap, messages), scan-poll.js (statuses, 3s x 10 polling decision), download-content-type.js, validate.js (stored-list check), evaluation.js (collection fields), form/ (field rules, add errors, page-order error sorting, payload parsing, retry), contracts/ (max 15 documents from the documents obligation, offered types from the document-types service, #documents-added anchor, upload id pattern and ownership, remove button), scan/ (status lookup, settling and virus summary errors), handlers/ (page load with scan status, download headers, upload details), view-model/ (render, table rows, status tags, refresh href, text and escaping), copy/ (copy.en.js quoted; copy.cy.js read for parity, marked machine-draft Welsh), client/ (drop-zone enhancement, scan polling and announcements, client oversize validation with error summary and field error). Fit specs read in full: upload.fit.spec.js (28 tests), scan-status.fit.spec.js (4), drop-zone.fit.spec.js (6), guidance.fit.spec.js (4) and axe.js (WCAG tags, serious/critical gate). The documents obligation's maxEntries (15) was looked up in obligations/sections/documents.js only to resolve MAX_DOCUMENTS; that file belongs to the obligation part.
